summary: Namibia's official Digital Nomad Visa runs 6 months, costs roughly $175, and requires $2,000/month income. Not renewable, but reapplication is allowed after 12 months.

program.name: Namibia Digital Nomad Visa
program.incomeNote: USD $2,000/month for the main applicant. USD $1,000/month for accompanying spouse. USD $500/month per accompanying child.
program.applicationFeeNote: NAD 3,300 (approximately USD $175-180). Paid after approval and before arrival, not at application.
program.renewalNote: Non-renewable. Must wait 12 months after expiry before reapplying.
program.processingNote: Processing time not publicly stated. Applications are submitted through NIPDB (Namibia Investment Promotion and Development Board), not directly to Home Affairs. NIPDB submits a motivation letter to the Ministry on your behalf.
program.workRestrictions: Cannot change immigration status while on this visa. Work must be for foreign employers only.
program.verificationNote: Confirmed from nipdb.com (Namibia Investment Promotion and Development Board), the official government agency administering this program in coordination with the Ministry of Home Affairs.

keyFacts: USD $2,000/month income required for main applicant
Must reapply through NIPDB, not Home Affairs directly
requirements: Proof of income (payslip or employment contract)
whyItMatters: Namibia is a standout remote work destination: stable, English-speaking, and genuinely uncrowded. The official program has real requirements (income proof, medical, police clearance) but the NIPDB process is straightforward. The 6-month limit with no renewal is the main constraint.
